content.text:
I fixed the broken anchor checker so a missing or extra trailing slash no longer gets a valid link reported as broken. A link like `/docs/php/tooling#phpunit` now passes when the page was rendered at `/docs/php/tooling/`.

**Cause:** The checker already ignored trailing-slash differences when checking whether the page exists. But for the anchor part (`#...`), it looked up the target page's collected anchors using the exact link path. Without the slash, that lookup found no page, so every anchor on it was reported as broken.

**Fix:** In `packages/docusaurus/src/server/brokenLinks.ts`, a new `getPageData` helper looks up the target page under several forms of the path: as written, URL-decoded, and each of those with and without a trailing slash. `isAnchorBrokenLink` now uses it to get the target page's anchors.

The existing broken-links test suite passes (34 tests). I didn't add a test for this exact case, and I didn't run a full site build.

One limitation: the anchor lookup ignores trailing slashes even for routes marked `strict`, which are slash-sensitive. In that rare case, the checker could accept an anchor link whose path form wouldn't actually match the route.
